description: This file defines data structures and interfaces related to payment processing, including a PaymentIntent dataclass, a PaymentProvider protocol, a mock implementation of the provider, and a factory function to get the provider.

classes.name: PaymentIntent
classes.description: Immutable dataclass representing a payment intent with provider details, order ID, amount, and currency.

classes.name: PaymentProvider
classes.description: Protocol defining the interface for payment provider implementations, requiring a create_payment_intent method.

classes.name: MockPaymentProvider
classes.description: Mock implementation of PaymentProvider that generates deterministic IDs and simulates payment intent creation.

methods.name: PaymentIntent create_payment_intent(self, *, order_id: UUID, amount_cents: int, currency: str)
methods.description: Method in PaymentProvider protocol to create a payment intent with specified order ID, amount, and currency.

methods.name: create_payment_intent
methods.description: Method in MockPaymentProvider that creates and returns a mock PaymentIntent with generated provider payment ID.

methods.name: PaymentProvider get_payment_provider()
methods.description: Function returning the active payment provider implementation, currently the mock provider.

ctags.name: create_payment_intent
ctags.pattern: /^    def create_payment_intent(self, *, order_id: UUID, amount_cents: int, currency: str) -> Paym/
ctags.signature: (self, *, order_id: UUID, amount_cents: int, currency: str)

ctags.name: create_payment_intent
ctags.pattern: /^    def create_payment_intent(self, *, order_id: UUID, amount_cents: int, currency: str) -> Paym/
ctags.signature: (self, *, order_id: UUID, amount_cents: int, currency: str)
